params.message:
The REST trend read leaves the graph out unless asked; unused assets and stale docs go

/api/v1/trends/{slug} still always carried the graph, which /mcp stopped doing in
2.0.0; it takes include_graph now, off by default. Collage parts 1 and 3 and the
wordmark PNG were used by no page; concurrently by no script. The agent-door design,
BRAND.md and the collage README described things that no longer exist.
